title: 第5章 第三次就轻车熟路了第6章 筑基异象
slug: 修炼就修炼你们别总想留宿啊
lines: 第五天傍晚。
林尘在修炼室里打坐了一下午，凝气丹当糖豆吃，体内的灵力涨了一大截。
炼气九层的境界已经彻底稳固，隐隐有往筑基期突破的苗头。
丹田里的灵力从之前的气态开始变得黏稠，像雾气在慢慢凝成水珠。
这是要筑基的前兆。
他睁开眼，看了看窗外的天色。
差不多了。
院门被敲响。
“进来吧，师尊。”
玉玲珑推门进来，穿着一身浅青色长裙，裙摆上绣着几片竹叶，走路的时候轻轻晃动。
头发又换了一种盘法，比上次盘得更高一点，露出修长的脖颈。
“你怎么知道是我？”
“这个时候除了师尊，还有谁会来？”
林尘从蒲团上站起来。
“而且师尊走路的声音我能听出来。”
玉玲珑看了他一眼，嘴角微微动了一下，像是想笑又压下去了。
“贫嘴。”
她没有坐下，直接站在修炼室门口，目光在他身上扫了一遍。
“你今天的灵力波动比昨天强了不少，是不是快要突破了？”
“弟子也觉得差不多了。丹田里的灵力已经开始液化，应该就是这两天的事。”
“那就今天。”
玉玲珑的语气不容置疑。
“在灵境空间里突破，比在外面安全得多。外面突破筑基会有异象，灵境空间能挡住大部分动静。”
“灵境空间？”
林尘眨了眨眼。
“系统之前确实解锁了这个功能，但弟子还没用过。”
“为师知道。”
玉玲珑的耳根已经开始发红，但语气还是保持着清冷。
“系统把为师默认成了辅助导师，能看到一部分功能。灵境空间是系统专门为你打造的双修空间，在里面双修效率翻倍，灵力损耗减半。最重要的是——突破的动静会被空间挡住，不会闹出之前那种异象。”
“师尊考虑得周到。”
林尘走到她面前。
“那现在就试试？”
玉玲珑伸出手。
“握住为师的手，意识跟着我走。”
林尘握住她的手。
content_en:
The evening of the fifth day.
Lin Chen meditated in the training room all afternoon, eating Qi Condensing Pills like jelly beans, and the spiritual power in his body increased a lot.
The realm of the ninth level of Qi Refining has been completely stabilized, and there are faint signs of a breakthrough to the foundation building stage.
The spiritual power in the Dantian began to become viscous from the previous gaseous state, like mist slowly condensing into water droplets.
This is a precursor to building a foundation.
He opened his eyes and looked at the sky outside the window.
That's almost it.
There was a knock on the courtyard door.
"Come in, Master."
Yu Linglong pushed open the door and came in, wearing a light cyan long skirt with a few bamboo leaves embroidered on the skirt, which swayed slightly when she walked.
Her hair was styled again, a little higher than last time, revealing her slender neck.
"How did you know it was me?"
"Other than Master, who else will come at this time?"
Lin Chen stood up from the futon.
"And I can hear the sound of Master walking."
Yu Linglong glanced at him and moved the corners of her mouth slightly, as if she wanted to smile but suppressed it.
"Poor mouth."
She did not sit down, but stood directly at the door of the training room, her eyes scanning him.
"Your spiritual power fluctuation today is much stronger than yesterday. Are you about to break through?"
"Disciple also feels that it's almost done. The spiritual power in the Dantian has begun to liquefy, and it should have happened in the past two days."
"Then today."
Yu Linglong's tone left no room for doubt.
"Breaking through in the spiritual space is much safer than outside. Breaking through the foundation outside will cause strange phenomena, and the spiritual space can block most movement."
"Spiritual space?"
Lin Chen blinked.
"The system did unlock this function before, but the disciple has not used it yet."
"Master knows."
The base of Yu Linglong's ears had begun to turn red, but her tone remained cool.
“系统把为师默认成了辅助导师，能看到一部分功能。灵境空间是系统专门为你打造的双修空间，在里面双修效率翻倍，灵力损耗减半。最重要的是——突破的动静会被空间挡住，不会闹出之前那种异象。”
"Master is very considerate."
Lin Chen walked up to her.
"Then try it now?"
"Yeah."
Yu Linglong stretched out her hand.
"Hold my master's hand and let your consciousness follow me."
Lin Chen held her hand.
